title: Toronto Western Hospital Patient Care Tower Growing on Bathurst
summary:
Toronto Western Hospital's new Patient Care Tower is growing taller on Bathurst Street just north of Dundas, with cladding now appearing on the lower floors. Designed by DIALOG for University Health Network, the 15-storey addition will expand the hospital with 82 patient beds, a new intensive care unit, and a state-of-the-art Medical Device Reprocessing Department, alongside publicly accessible landscaping and community space.
